name: omni-api
description: Omni's API (its public image at release v2.261024.2 by digest), wired by DATABASE_URL and NATS_URL: link it to postgres-autopg and to nats. Its OMNI_API_KEY is made by Arca at create (Omni takes it at its first start with a database and keeps it); telegram_bot_token and whatsapp_phone_number are the owner's, for Arca's omni tools only, never its environment. A link to it gives OMNI_API_URL.
